name: Extract Utility Functions
description: Extract common utility functions from multiple files into a shared utils module
prompt: Refactor the codebase to extract common utility functions. Create src/utils/date.ts with formatDate and parseDate functions. Update all files that use these functions to import from the new utils module.

validation.command: grep -r 'function formatDate' src/ | grep -v 'utils/date.ts' | wc -l | grep -q '^0$'

expectedInvariants: Single source of truth for date utilities
